description: Soon You'll Get Better is so devastating I genuinely can't listen to it without sobbing 😭😭 It's about her mom and it is TOO real, like girl I came here for the breakup tea not to feel this. It's beautiful and gutting and I cry every single time, but I have to skip it sometimes for my own mental health. A masterpiece but I can't rate it high because it ruins my mascara 💅🥹
